title: nvim crashes when `visualbell` is enabled

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v0.9.0-dev-590+g6ba34e21f

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

no

### Operating system/version

Linux

### Terminal name/version

wezterm 20221221-163401-72da5d16

### $TERM environment variable

wezterm

### Installation

Built from git head today

### How to reproduce the issue

nvim aborts instantly when visualbell is on and the bell rings (e.g. by moving the cursor out of bounds).
